name: Malcolm
description: Malcolm is a siren pirate on Ixalan, navigator of the Belligerent under Vraska and a lifelong member of the Brazen Coalition.

summary.text: Malcolm is a siren pirate on Ixalan, navigator of the Belligerent under Vraska and a lifelong member of the Brazen Coalition.

bio.text: As navigator under Vraska's captaincy he took Jace and Vraska aside to explain the history of the Immortal Sun, which was stolen from Torrezon and carried west.
During the race for Orazca he saw the city ahead through the fog as it began rising from the jungle, and in the Sun chamber his song enthralled everyone until Breeches leaped onto Vona's face.
He and Breeches later decided to run away together, and Jace sent a farewell message for the crew through him.
Sent as Downtown's official emissary to investigate why it had gone silent, he found it empty and followed the missing residents down the mine.
He and Breeches cut the elevator cables on the infected pirates, then met the Mycotyrant, which said it wanted the sun above.
He sang to stun the colony and escaped, flew into the Core to report the Mycotyrant, and after the battle found Sunray Bay deserted and decided to warn High and Dry.
Later, a winged siren on Oko's crew did reconnaissance, and Vraska had recruited Malcolm and Breeches in High and Dry.

status.text: As of the latest story, Malcolm is alive and has served on Oko's crew, having earlier been recruited by Vraska on Ixalan.

timeline.summary: Months later Vraska captains The Belligerent, and the compass directs her crew south.
timeline.quote: Set course due south,

timeline.summary: A Legion of Dusk ship appears and Vraska recalls an earlier attack and the vampires' pursuit of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun was stolen from their monasteries

timeline.summary: The crew boards the vampire ship and takes it by surprise.
timeline.quote: The vampires were caught completely off guard.

timeline.summary: Malcolm takes Jace and Vraska to the Boatswain's Rear for a private briefing.
timeline.quote: He opened the door (an old galley table with a knife still stuck in it)

timeline.summary: Malcolm explains the history of the Immortal Sun, stolen from Torrezon and carried west.
timeline.quote: a winged being descended from the sky. It took the Immortal Sun

timeline.summary: A storm and a Legion of Dusk ship converge as the ship nears Ixalan, and Vraska orders abandon ship.
timeline.quote: Jace saw the Legion of Dusk ship coasting atop the water.

timeline.summary: Jace conjures a glowing illusory draft horse as a beacon for Malcolm and the crew.
timeline.quote: A large draft horse materialized above them, glowing a delicate blue against the night sky, and ran upward into the canopy.

timeline.summary: The compass vibrates and Malcolm sees the city ahead as the crew runs through the fog and mountains.
timeline.quote: It's on the hills ahead!

timeline.summary: An earthquake shakes the clearing and Orazca begins rising from the jungle.
timeline.quote: The city itself was emerging from the jungle with every jostle of the earthquake.

timeline.summary: Malcolm says someone must have arrived at the city first, and a great beast bellows.
timeline.quote: Someone must have arrived at the city first.

timeline.summary: Breeches charges the tower shouting for the Sun while Malcolm flies above.
timeline.quote: WE WANT SUN! WE WANT SUN!

timeline.summary: Malcolm's song enthralls everyone in the chamber until Breeches leaps onto Vona's face.
timeline.quote: The goblin leaped forward onto Vona's face.

timeline.summary: Breeches and Malcolm hear Jace and the floor gives way beneath the standoff.
timeline.quote: Malcolm, you heard Jace too?!

timeline.summary: Jace sends Vraska's message to her crew, leaving Amelia in charge.
timeline.quote: Tell them to return to the ship, Amelia's in charge

timeline.summary: Breeches and Malcolm decide to run away.
timeline.quote: RUNNING AWAY!

timeline.summary: Jace sends Malcolm a farewell message for the crew.
timeline.quote: Captain is safe, but far away

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Breeches, told by Jace to let Vraska go, find Orazca empty (non-canon pirate ending).
timeline.quote: Captain's orders are to let her go, Breeches.

timeline.summary: Breeches notes everyone else has left Orazca.
timeline.quote: Orazca empty,

timeline.summary: A week later the Belligerent's crew carouses in Azor's old sanctum on looted gold, with Malcolm and Breeches as co-emperors.
timeline.quote: Will you join me for ale and cards, Co-Emperor Breeches?

timeline.summary: Malcolm examines a fungus-ridden corpse near Sunray Bay.
timeline.quote: The body slumped in a pile of half-rotted leaves in the jungle, close enough to Sunray Bay that Malcolm could have walked instead of flying.

timeline.summary: Malcolm identifies the dead man as Lank, a Downtown miner.
timeline.quote: I think this is Lank

timeline.summary: The note found on Lank, signed by mayor Xavier Sal, reveals Downtown is under attack.
timeline.quote: Downtown under attack , it read.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and his companions find Downtown completely empty and abandoned.
timeline.quote: The lamps were dark, and as far as Malcolm could tell, Downtown was entirely empty

timeline.summary: Malcolm finds the word DOWN painted in ichor beside the one lowered elevator and sends a companion back to Sunray Bay.
timeline.quote: One word, the letters thick and blocky.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and his crew descend elevator after elevator in the Downtown cenote, finding tracks of the missing residents all leading downward.
timeline.quote: each showed signs of its workers joining the mass exodus, ever downward.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Breeches find a trail of abandoned tools and smeared greenish-black marks leading into a tunnel.
timeline.quote: A haphazard trail of tools seemed to lead into one of the tunnels rather than out, though it was hard to tell the difference.

timeline.summary: In a fungus-lit cavern they find stripped, mold-covered bones and see shapes moving in the dark.
timeline.quote: A pile of bones stripped clean of flesh and half-covered in black mold.

timeline.summary: A fungus-ridden living raptor corpse attacks, releasing spores, and more like it follow; Malcolm flees with Breeches.
timeline.quote: A horror emerged from the passage beside them.

timeline.summary: Malcolm sings to enthrall the fungus-ridden dinosaurs and his crew, and cuts the creatures apart.
timeline.quote: Malcolm began to sing.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Breeches regroup, then notice black fungal veins spreading from the crew's wounds, though everyone says they feel fine.
timeline.quote: Black marks like scabs had replaced slices and gouges

timeline.summary: On the elevator, spore-infected pirates shove uninjured crewmates into a spore cloud and turn them.
timeline.quote: those pirates lunged at two of the uninjured ones and shoved them into the glowing spore cloud.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Breeches cut the cables, sending the elevator with the infected pirates falling into the dark.
timeline.quote: with a terrible silence, the elevator fell away into the dark.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Breeches rest in an abandoned tunnel as the only survivors of Malcolm's party.
timeline.quote: of the eight people he'd brought down here with him, only he and Breeches had survived.

timeline.summary: Fungus on the shaft wall spells out the words SAFE and DOWN, suggesting the force behind Downtown's fate is sentient.
timeline.quote: SAFE, the first word read. Then, DOWN.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Breeches fly and climb down the cenote and find the damaged elevator.
timeline.quote: They eventually found the elevator, damaged but mostly intact

timeline.summary: A glowing tunnel seems to guide or herd them onward.
timeline.quote: A tunnel to the left lit up while the glow around them faded, as if they were being guided.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Breeches enter a vast fungal forest full of ruins.
timeline.quote: A fungal forest spread out before them, hauntingly beautiful, littered with crumbling ruins.

timeline.summary: Downtown's infected residents emerge, led by mayor Xavier Sal with button mushrooms for eyes.
timeline.quote: One of the humans stepped forward, his movements stilted, eyes replaced by glowing button mushrooms.

timeline.summary: Xavier announces that they are the Mycotyrant, and the giant fungal creature is revealed.
timeline.quote: We are the Mycotyrant.

timeline.summary: Xavier says Malcolm's companions and Downtown's residents have been incorporated into the colony.
timeline.quote: They have been incorporated into our colony, as have the ones who once resided in the place you call Downtown.

timeline.summary: When Malcolm asks what it wants, the Mycotyrant laughs with spores and answers 'Everything.'
timeline.quote: The Mycotyrant emitted a cloud of spores like a silent laugh.

timeline.summary: The Mycotyrant explains that its colony found the miners and wanted to know more of them.
timeline.quote: You dug through stone and ore and veins of shining crystal until one of your kind found us.

timeline.summary: Xavier says the Mycotyrant does not kill but changes and spreads.
timeline.quote: We do not kill. We change. We spread.

timeline.summary: The Mycotyrant reveals it wants the sun above and Malcolm realizes it could consume Sunray Bay and Ixalan.
timeline.quote: You have another sun above, and we will have it.

timeline.summary: The Mycotyrant announces it will assimilate Malcolm and Breeches and ascend to the surface.
timeline.quote: We will assimilate you, and we will ascend to the surface and its sun.

timeline.summary: Malcolm sings to stun the colony and leads Breeches toward a water tunnel.
timeline.quote: Taking a deep breath, Malcolm began to sing.

timeline.summary: The Mycotyrant breaks free of the song with a scream and the colony chases them.
timeline.quote: A hideous, many-mouthed scream echoed behind them.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Breeches burst out above a vast ocean and the River Heralds' city.
timeline.quote: Without warning, the tunnel ended in a short cliff.

timeline.summary: The Mycotyrant's forces, including infected Downtown residents, dinosaurs and bats, erupt after them.
timeline.quote: The Mycotyrant's forces erupted from the tunnel.

timeline.summary: Nicanzil confronts Malcolm and Breeches, then agrees the Core must be warned.
timeline.quote: I am Nicanzil. What evil have you brought to our shores?

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Breeches head through the golden door to warn the Core.
timeline.quote: Our people beyond the golden door must be warned that it is closer than they knew.

timeline.summary: Wayta sees a siren fleeing from the door and a flood of fungal creatures behind him.
timeline.quote: A rush of greenish blackness poured through the portal behind him.

timeline.summary: Malcolm flies into the Core and finds a battle already underway.
timeline.quote: there appeared to be another battle already in progress.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Wayta meet in the air and exchange news of the mushroom horde and the bat monsters.
timeline.quote: The vampires have transformed into bat monsters and their god imprisoned the sun.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Wayta reach Quint, Amalia, Kellan and Akal, and Malcolm reports the Mycotyrant.
timeline.quote: I am Steward Akal, and you seem to have brought us more trouble.

timeline.summary: Malcolm recalls that Vraska reportedly died in the invasion.
timeline.quote: She'd died in the invasion, or so he'd heard.

timeline.summary: Amalia carves a fissure in front of the Mycotyrant's army.
timeline.quote: a deep crevice lay in the path of the army, encircling them so retreat would be difficult.

timeline.summary: The mycoids bridge the fissure with their own bodies.
timeline.quote: soon a thick bridge spanned the crevice.

timeline.summary: Echoes destroy mycoids by entering them as a counter-infection.
timeline.quote: It dissolved into blue smoke as if consumed by invisible fire.

timeline.summary: Breeches pulls out a flowery tube weapon he got in High and Dry.
timeline.quote: From his pack, he retrieved the weapon he'd acquired in High and Dry as payment for a debt.

timeline.summary: Breeches fires a molten fireball that fells a titan and sends the colony into disarray.
timeline.quote: Every fungal creature around it shrieked in unison, some collapsing like puppets whose strings had been cut.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Breeches climb out of the caverns and head for Sunray Bay.
timeline.quote: Climbing back out of the caverns had almost been worse than going in.

timeline.summary: Sunray Bay is found deserted and marked by spores.
timeline.quote: Sunray Bay was as deserted as Downtown, with the same signs of the Mycotyrant's handiwork

timeline.summary: Malcolm decides to warn High and Dry.
timeline.quote: We need to get to High and Dry

timeline.summary: Annie meets Breeches, Malcolm and Tinybones at the Wildcard Saloon, where Oko is waiting behind the bar.
timeline.quote: "Care for a drink?" Oko's voice sounded from behind the bar.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Oko, disguised as Sterling guards, ride the train with Umezawa while the rest of the crew watches over a telepathic link.
timeline.quote: The moment Oko's voice pressed into Kellan's mind, he flinched.

timeline.summary: The crew fights the Hellspurs while Kaervek works, and Vraska suggests she and Oko must reach the treasure at any cost.
timeline.quote: "You and I need to reach the vault's treasure room. No matter the cost."

timeline.summary: The crew flees the collapsing vault on Rakdos's back.
timeline.quote: The team fled back through the corridor as the sound of the vault being ripped apart roared behind them.

timeline.summary: Six months earlier, Vraska recruits Breeches and Malcolm in High and Dry.
timeline.quote: "Hello, boys. You sound like you need a job."

relations.note: Malcolm calls Jace an excellent pirate and crewmate.
relations.quote: You'll always be a crewmate, Jace

relations.note: they meet in the air and join forces
relations.quote: Malcolm raced toward her, and she did the same
